answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 1430 Country: India Title: After intercourse the sweat of an individual is holy or not? Question: After intercourse the sweat of an individual is holy or not? Answer ID: 1430 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 834/834=J) The sweat of junubi (one who had intercourse) is tahir (pure/clean): قال فی الھندیۃ: عرق کل شئ معتبر بسؤرہ کذا فی الھدایۃ ۔۔۔۔ سؤر الآدمی طاھر و یدخل فی ھذا الجنب ۔۔۔۔ کذا فی السراج الوھاج (الفتاوی الھندیۃ: 1/23) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
